utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces myself, Gus—have they actually started collecting supplies yet, or are folks still just getting organized?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’ve started collecting a bit—some folks are already bringing spare parts and maybe extension cords, but I’m still keeping an ear out for whether we’re short on basic hand tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Ah, that’s helpful—I’d only heard second-hand, so it sounds like it’s properly underway then. I might stop by the hall and ask if they still need basic tools or help with the smaller jobs.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll keep spreading the word that it’s Sunday at the community center, and they still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess—that helps a ton. Please keep reminding folks it’s Sunday at the community center, and only to bring tools they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Rosa—I’ll keep telling folks it’s Sunday at the community center, and that they still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, just easy-to-carry things.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the shed roof’s still first on the list, and Saturday at the usual time should be right. Thanks for checking in, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ve got tape, gloves, and water in decent shape, but we’re still short on work lights. I’m asking around now and I’ll text you the count as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo. If you can find even one or two lights, that should help a lot with the roof.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we haul anything over, can Jules confirm the drop-off spot and whether the shared list still just has the screwdrivers, hammer, and small step stool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t confirmed the drop-off spot yet, Pia, but the last thing I heard was they still needed a few basic hand tools and Mara might be bringing extension cords. I’ll check what’s still missing when I stop by and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules—please pin down the drop-off spot first, and then we can see if the list is still just the screwdrivers, hammer, and small step stool so nobody brings extras.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Mina—have we heard the latest on the sign-up count yet, or what they still need us to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet—I'm still waiting on the latest count, but can you check whether they still need more volunteers or any specific tools for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again, Mina—I’ll check while I’m out and let you know as soon as I hear whether they still need more volunteers or any specific tools for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help mid-morning after school drop-off, and I’m still double-checking that it’s just small household fixes and bike repairs and whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, yes, I think it’s still the community shed at the usual time, and mid-morning should work nicely. I’m fuzzy on the pickups bit too, but I can bring my spare screwdriver set if I remember it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, mid-morning after drop-off still works for me, and I’ll keep checking on whether it’s just the household fixes and bike repairs and if Malik’s definitely doing pickups.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Bo, let’s keep the repair drive simple: we still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and folks should only bring what they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—text me the time again, and I’ll see who I can point you to for the screwdrivers, hammer, and step stool.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Bo — it starts at 9 on Saturday, and if you can point me to anyone with a screwdriver, hammer, or small step stool, that should cover the basics.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ira, before I pass this along, can you confirm the repair drive is definitely this weekend, who finalized the schedule, and whether Malik’s confirmed for pickups?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can’t confirm any of that yet—I’m still waiting to hear back from the organizers today. As soon as I get the schedule, timing, and pickup details, I’ll pass it straight along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — please let me know once the organizers confirm the weekend, who finalized the schedule, and whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not fully locked yet, Leo—I’m still tracking the exact drop-off spot and tool list, and I’ll share the location details as soon as Ira confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I'm on the shed roof first, then I’ll head to the drive for the simple fixes once you send the spot and tool list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Leo—I’ve got you marked for simple fixes after the shed roof, and I’ll send you the drop-off spot and tool list the minute Ira confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d wait for Faye’s confirmation before calling it settled—last I heard, she was checking the repair list, the drop-off spot, and whether Malik’s definitely on pickups.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—I’ll hold off and wait for Faye to confirm the repair list, drop-off spot, and Malik’s pickups before I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s probably best—once Faye confirms those details, we’ll have one clean update to pass around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still spreading the word, Sam, and once Rosa confirms the exact time and place I’ll keep passing it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik—that helps a lot. I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the exact time, place, and a few repair details, but I’ll pass it on as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good—I’ll keep telling people the repair drive is coming up, and once Rosa confirms the exact time and place I’ll spread that around too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—thanks, I keep losing track of this stuff. Just text me the time when you get it, and I’ll plan on the community shed Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can we just confirm with Ira first that it’s definitely Saturday at the community shed before either of us commits?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, good call—can you check with Ira? I’d rather make sure before I put it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, and bottled water covered pretty well, but we’re still short on work lights for the repair drive. I’m asking around the block now and I’ll text you the count once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—that helps. I haven’t heard the final repair list or pickup confirmation yet either, but if you text me the work-light count, I can keep an ear out one-on-one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks—right now I’m hearing it’s still small household fixes and bike repairs, and I’m still waiting on final word about Malik’s pickups. I’ll text you the work-light count as soon as I hear back from the block.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—that helps a lot. I’ll text you what tools are still missing once I check in, and if Cleo or Oren have leads, I’d really appreciate the connection.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just text me the short list, and I’ll point you to Cleo or Oren if they’ve got it covered.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do—thanks, Bo. I’m checking in on the missing basics now, and I’ll send you the short list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning, Rosa. We’re starting with the shed roof leak on Saturday, and I can bring the screwdriver set over before we begin.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Morning, Uli—that screwdriver set would help, thank you. Just a heads-up, the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so please bring only what’s easy to carry.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for telling me, Rosa. I’ll bring just the screwdriver set on Sunday, then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps — I can do mid-morning after drop-off, and just keep me posted once pickups are confirmed since I need to plan around school pickup too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still waiting on final word about the repair list and whether Malik’s definitely handling pickups, so for now plan on carry-in repairs mid-morning after drop-off and I’ll send you one clean update as soon as it’s locked in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks — that works for me, and I’ll hold mid-morning after drop-off for now while I wait for your update on the repair list and pickups.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Before we get too far, can we confirm the tool list and pick one drop-off spot? I don’t want people bringing duplicates or leaving things scattered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—before we set anything up, can you remind me which repairs the drive is covering and who’s organizing pickups, and has the schedule for this weekend actually been finalized?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: From what I’ve heard it’s mostly small fixes, and the basic needs were a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, but I don’t think pickups or the weekend schedule should be treated as set until Eli confirms the drop-off spot and who’s handling what.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces myself, Ira, but it sounds like folks are already getting organized. I’m thinking I’ll check the hall and ask what they still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s perfect, Nell—if they’ve got a fresh sign-up count or need extra hands or tools, tell me and I’ll spread the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do—I’m still piecing it together from what I’ve heard, but I’ll ask at the hall and let you know if they’ve started collecting supplies or need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Tess, far as I know it’s still the community shed at the usual time, and I’ll text before I head over in case Mara’s heard anything different.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren—if Mara’s heard anything, let me know, because last I heard it was Sunday at the community center and they still needed a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks, Tess—that might be me mixing up the shed and the center again. I’ve got a spare screwdriver set, and I’ll check with Mara and text you before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Leo—I’ll look for you by the community shed early Saturday, and thanks again for bringing the spare screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I’m still bringing the screwdriver set and I’ll stop by after I start on the shed roof.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Leo—I’ll be there early with the tables, signage, signup sheet, and donation box, so I’ll catch you by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, and once Rosa gives the exact time and place I’ll make sure everyone hears that too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Vik—once Rosa confirms the time and drop-off spot, send it my way and I’ll pair it with the addresses so we keep the repair requests organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Opal—I’ll keep telling people about the repair drive, and the moment Rosa confirms the exact time and drop-off spot, I’ll pass it along to you too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the repair list and pickups, but Mara’s set for the usual shed time with the signup sheet and donation box.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but are we actually confirmed for this weekend at the shed, or is that still tentative? I just don’t want to commit before we hear it clearly from the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s still a bit tentative until the organizers confirm it clearly, so I wouldn’t lock anything in just yet. I’m checking with them and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus, let’s keep it clear: we still need a couple of screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and folks should only bring what they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, Eli—I’ll keep telling folks we still need a couple screwdrivers, a hammer, and a small step stool, and only to bring what they can carry themselves.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus—that keeps it simple. If anyone asks, have them bring just one of those items so we don’t end up with duplicates.
